critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1612 GET /api/tasks/archive is correctly registered AFTER GET /api/tasks (line 1540) and BEFORE no /tasks/{task_id} GET exists, so FastAPI path conflict is not an issue. ✓

server.py:1597 delete RBAC uses created_by name string equality. If a user is renamed after creating the task, equality would break and the original creator would lose delete rights. Consider storing created_by as user_id (UUID) instead of name.
server.py:1626 restore endpoint requires tasks 'write' permission; admin or original creator only. Good.
server.py:430 status check uses lower() on stripped string — accepts 'Aktiv'/'aktiv'/'Active'/'active'. Anything else is blocked. Good defensive normalization.
Tasks.jsx:121 setTasks(prev => [created, ...prev]) — optimistic insert works correctly because backend returns the complete created object including task_code and created_at. ✓
Tasks.jsx:136-141 canDeleteTask: client-side gate matches server rule (admin or creator==me). Both layers enforce the rule, defense in depth. ✓

Attendance.jsx fetchSessions correctly destructures {sessions, totals} from the new response shape. Excel export should already include the totals sheet — main agent should verify by clicking the Excel button manually (we did not download/inspect the xlsx file, only confirmed the button is rendered).
Settings.jsx:498-504 getRoleBadge falls back to violet-badge with custom role name verbatim — clean implementation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 fixes in this batch are verified at both backend (pytest 9/9) and frontend (Playwright UI assertions) layers. Key route ordering: GET /api/tasks/archive must remain before any /api/tasks/{task_id} dynamic GET (currently no such dynamic GET exists). RBAC for task delete: admin OR creator (name-based equality). For Excel export verification, downloading the xlsx file was not attempted — the button is rendered; main agent can validate sheets by manual click. The 'TEST_Deactivated' and 'TEST_Reactivate' entries visible in totals are historical session traces and are NOT a bug.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — this iteration verified a feature batch rather than fixing a bug. All 6 changes implement as described in the review request: (a) login active check via status field normalization, (b) Settings users page renders unknown role names verbatim, (c) task card UI uses flex-col stacked dates with conditional rose-50/rose-600 highlight, (d) optimistic state update in Tasks.jsx setTasks([created, ...prev]), (e) DELETE /tasks/{id} now performs insert→tasks_archive then delete→tasks atomically with 403 guard, plus new GET /tasks/archive and POST /tasks/archive/{id}/restore endpoints, (f) system-sessions response reshaped to {sessions, totals} with per-user aggregation; UI consumes 'totals' for the new 'Bu gün toplam' card and exportSessions adds a 'Toplam' sheet.
